description: Type prefixes, classification spec §3. Assigned once per source in the registry, looked up thereafter. Structured records take TEC regardless of publisher.

members.covers: Government agency, advisory, statement, court filing, indictment
Commercial security vendor research, IR reporting, blog
Academic research, whether or not peer-reviewed
Structured record: CVE entry, KEV catalog, RFC, repository, patch note, certificate log
Independent researcher, personal blog, conference talk
Non-profit and community: Shadowserver, Spamhaus, Team Cymru, ISACs, non-governmental CERTs
Automated aggregator or machine-generated summary: threat feeds that restate other reporting, AI-written digests, auto-summarized newsletters
Social and messaging platform post from a non-adversary account: researcher threads, channel posts, forum discussion
Adversary-controlled: leak site, ransom note, actor claim, forum ad
The author. This product's own judgment, not a source
